stateNote: In a heavy frying pan, fry the tortillas, one at a time, in very hot olive oil as follows: Dip a tortilla in the tomato sauce. Fry for a minute each side in the pan. Remove the tortilla to a warm plate and place about ¼ cup of sausage mixture in the centre. Roll up the tortilla with the filling inside.
